# Mushafuk — further Arabic tafsirs

> Additional Arabic Quran commentaries, ayah by ayah, at https://t2.mushafuk.online. Part of Mushafuk (https://mushafuk.online). Free, no ads.

This host publishes a smaller set of Arabic tafsirs as static HTML. Each book has a catalogue page and pages for the ayahs that have text in that book. The larger tafsir catalogue is https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/.

## Start here

- [Catalogue](https://t2.mushafuk.online/)
- [Main tafsir catalogue](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/)
- [Madinah mushaf](https://mushafuk.online/)
- [FAQ](https://t2.mushafuk.online/faq.html)

## Books

- [Daqa'iq al-Tafsir](https://t2.mushafuk.online/taymiyyah/) — collected comments of Ibn Taymiyyah
- [Ibn al-Mundhir](https://t2.mushafuk.online/mundhir/)
- [Rawa'i' al-Tafsir](https://t2.mushafuk.online/rajab/) — Ibn Rajab al-Hanbali
- [Mujahid ibn Jabr](https://t2.mushafuk.online/mujahid/)
- [Abd al-Razzaq al-San'ani](https://t2.mushafuk.online/razzaq/)

## Addresses

- One book, one ayah: https://t2.mushafuk.online/{id}/{surah}/{ayah}/
- Book ids: taymiyyah, mundhir, rajab, mujahid, razzaq
- Example: https://t2.mushafuk.online/mujahid/

## Languages

The tafsir text is Arabic. Short FAQ pages also exist in Azerbaijani, English, Russian, and Turkish.
